time.en: 15 min | Cook: 60 min | Total: not given

c.t: Baking powder (not baking soda) makes the skin even crisper by producing tiny air bubbles in it; it is optional.
Prášok do pečiva (nie jedlá sóda) urobí kožu ešte chrumkavejšou, pretože v nej vytvorí drobné vzduchové bublinky; je nepovinný.

en.t: 1 tbsp (9 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt use half as much by volume or the same weight
1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) freshly ground black pepper (optional)
1 tsp (5 g) baking powder (optional)
1 large chicken, about 1800–2300 g, giblets removed and wing tips trimmed and reserved for stock
1 tbsp (15 ml) neutral-flavored oil, such as canola or vegetable, plus more for rubbing

1. In a small bowl, thoroughly mix the salt with black pepper and baking powder (if using). Season chicken all over, inside and out, with salt mixture (or just plain salt if not using pepper and baking powder).

2. Set chicken, breast side up, on work surface and tuck wings behind back. Using butcher's twine, run the center of the twine under the tip of the tail end and truss chicken by tying drumsticks together at their bony ends, securing the legs and the tip of the tail together in a bundle. Criss-cross the twine and pass along the crevasse where the legs meet the breast; pass twine over wings to hold them into place, then tie securely around the stump of the neck. Place chicken, back side down, on a wire rack set in a rimmed baking sheet and refrigerate, uncovered, at least 1 hour and up to 2 days.

3. Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 220 °C (fan 200 °C). In a 25 cm or 30 cm stainless steel skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat until shimmering. Rub chicken lightly with oil, set it on its side in the skillet so that the full thigh and drumstick are in contact with the pan; the wing will also be touching, but the breast should have little to no contact with the skillet. Cook until leg is well browned, 8 to 10 minutes, then flip bird so other leg is touching pan and repeat; lower heat at any point if chicken skin begins to burn.

4. Using hands and spatula if needed, rotate chicken so it is breast side up in the skillet and transfer to oven. Roast until breast registers 65 °C in the center of its thickest part and thighs register 75 °C near (but not touching) the bone, about 40 minutes. Remove from oven and transfer chicken to a carving board. Let rest 10 to 20 minutes, then carve and serve.

1. V malej miske dôkladne zmiešame soľ s čiernym korením a kypriacim práškom (ak ho používame). Kura touto zmesou osolíme zo všetkých strán, zvonka aj zvnútra (alebo len samotnou soľou, ak korenie a kypriaci prášok nepoužívame).

2. Kura položíme na pracovnú plochu prsiami nahor a krídla zastrčíme za chrbát. Stred mäsiarskeho špagátu podvlečieme pod koniec chvosta a kura previažeme tak, že stehná zviažeme na kostnatých koncoch a nohy spolu so špičkou chvosta stiahneme do zväzku. Špagát prekrížime a vedieme ho pozdĺž žliabku, kde sa stehná stretávajú s prsiami; prevedieme ho cez krídla, aby ich držal na mieste, a pevne zaviažeme okolo pahýľa krku. Kura položíme chrbtom nadol na mriežku vloženú do plechu s okrajom a necháme v chladničke odkryté aspoň 1 hodinu a najviac 2 dni.

3. Rošt nastavíme do stredu rúry a rúru predhrejeme na 220 °C (teplovzdušnú na 200 °C). V nerezovej panvici s priemerom 25 alebo 30 cm rozohrejeme na stredne silnom až silnom ohni olej, kým sa neleskne. Kura zľahka potrieme olejom a položíme ho do panvice na bok tak, aby sa celé stehno a palička dotýkali dna; krídlo sa bude tiež dotýkať, ale prsia by sa panvice mali dotýkať len málo alebo vôbec. Opekáme, kým stehno pekne nezhnedne, 8 až 10 minút, potom vtáka otočíme na druhý bok a postup zopakujeme; ak by koža začala pripaľovať, oheň kedykoľvek stlmíme.

4. Rukami a podľa potreby obracačkou kura v panvici otočíme prsiami nahor a vložíme do rúry. Pečieme, kým prsia v strede najhrubšej časti nedosiahnu 65 °C a stehná pri kosti (ale nie na kosti) 75 °C, asi 40 minút. Vyberieme z rúry a kura preložíme na dosku na krájanie. Necháme odpočívať 10 až 20 minút, potom nakrájame a podávame.

src: Ottolenghi — Yotam Ottolenghi — "Southern fried chicken"

time.en: not given | Cook: not given | Total: not given

en.t: 1 medium onion, peeled and sliced
2 cloves garlic, skin on, crushed
12 bay leaves
8 allspice berries
3 tbsp (44 ml) white wine vinegar
1 tbsp (12 g) soft brown or caster sugar
fine sea salt
12 chicken thighs, bone in and skin on
150 g plain flour
1 tbsp (15 ml) freshly ground white pepper
2 tsp (10 ml) sweet paprika
3 tbsp (44 ml) coriander seeds, lightly crushed
1 tbsp (12 g) baking powder
285 ml buttermilk
1 litre sunflower oil, for frying

1. Pour a litre of tap water into a large saucepan and add the onion, garlic, bay, all spice, vinegar, sugar and a tbsp of salt. Bring to a boil, remove from the heat and set aside to cool; about an hour should do. Add the chicken thighs, making sure they are fully submerged, cover and leave in the fridge for 24 hours to marinate, stirring from time to time.

2. Heat the oven to 200 °C (fan 180 °C). Rinse the chicken, discarding the brine, and pat dry very well. Put the flour, white pepper, paprika, coriander seeds, baking powder and a tsp of salt in a bowl and mix well. Pour the buttermilk into a separate bowl. Dip the chicken thighs one by one into the buttermilk – they need just a thin coating, so brush against the rim of the bowl to remove any excess – then coat with the flour mixture. You want an even yet thin coat.

3. Pour enough oil into a large sauté pan so that it rises 4 cm up the sides. Place on a medium-high heat and use a thermometer to bring the oil to 170 °C (if you don't have a thermometer, the oil needs to keep sizzling away when you're frying the chicken, but only moderately so). Working in batches, so as not to overcrowd the pan and thus lower the temperature of the oil, gently lower the chicken thighs into the oil and cook for nine minutes, turning once. Transfer to a kitchen towel-lined plate and keep warm while you cook the rest of the chicken.
4. Transfer the thighs to a baking tray and finish them off in the oven for a further eight to 12 minutes, until cooked through. Leave to rest for five minutes before serving.

sugar/sweetener reduced to 50% ("1 tbsp (12 g) soft brown or caster sugar") — own adjustment

1. Do veľkého hrnca nalejeme liter vody z vodovodu a pridáme cibuľu, cesnak, bobkový list, nové korenie, ocot, cukor a polievkovú lyžicu soli. Privedieme do varu, odstavíme z ohňa a necháme vychladnúť; zhruba 1 hodina by mala stačiť. Pridáme kuracie stehná tak, aby boli úplne ponorené, prikryjeme a necháme 24 hodín marinovať v chladničke, z času na čas premiešame.

2. Rúru rozohrejeme na 200 °C (teplovzdušnú na 180 °C). Kura opláchneme, nálev vylejeme a mäso veľmi dobre osušíme. Do misy dáme múku, biele korenie, papriku, koriandrové semienka, kypriaci prášok a čajovú lyžičku soli a dobre premiešame. Do inej misy nalejeme skysnuté mlieko. Stehná po jednom namáčame do skysnutého mlieka – stačí tenká vrstva, preto prebytok otrieme o okraj misy – a potom ich obalíme v múčnej zmesi. Obal má byť rovnomerný, no tenký.

3. Do veľkej panvice na restovanie nalejeme toľko oleja, aby siahal 4 cm vysoko. Postavíme na stredne silný až silný oheň a podľa teplomera olej zohrejeme na 170 °C (ak teplomer nemáme, olej má počas vyprážania stále syčať, no len mierne). Vyprážame po dávkach, aby sme panvicu nepreplnili a neznížili teplotu oleja: stehná opatrne vložíme do oleja a vyprážame 9 minút, raz ich otočíme. Preložíme na tanier vystlaný utierkou a udržiavame v teple, kým vyprážame zvyšok.
4. Stehná preložíme na plech a v rúre dopekáme ďalších 8 až 12 minút, kým nie sú úplne prepečené. Pred podávaním necháme päť minút odpočívať.

en.k: Air-fryer option (sourced: Serious Eats, "Air-Fried Southern Fried Chicken": https://www.seriouseats.com/air-fried-southern-fried-chicken-recipe-11801085)
en.v: instead of frying as in the method below, the dish can be made in the air fryer.

c.t: Oil: 1 tbsp oil drizzled over the foil-lined basket for each batch, plus oil spray on the chicken (as in the source)
Air fryer: 195 °C, preheat 3 min; thighs 22–25 min, turning and spraying halfway, to 77 °C inside
Steps:

1. Brine and dredge the chicken as in steps 1–2, but heat the oven only to 110 °C (fan 90 °C) to keep cooked batches warm. Pierce a sheet of aluminium foil all over with a fork, line the basket with it, drizzle 1 tbsp oil over the foil and preheat the air fryer to 195 °C for 3 minutes.
2. Lay a batch of thighs on the foil, skin side down, without crowding, and spray them all over with oil until no dry flour is visible.
3. Air-fry until golden and crisp and 77 °C inside, 22–25 minutes, turning the thighs and spraying them again halfway. Keep each cooked batch warm in the oven while the rest cook (as in the source).
4. Repeat with the remaining thighs, adding 1 tbsp oil to the foil for each batch, and let rest for 10 minutes before serving (as in the source).

en.v: oven 220 °C (fan 200 °C) on a rack over a lined tray, about 1.5–2× the air-fryer time, turning halfway.

sk.v: teplovzdušná fritéza (zdroj: Serious Eats, „Air-Fried Southern Fried Chicken“: https://www.seriouseats.com/air-fried-southern-fried-chicken-recipe-11801085): namiesto vyprážania podľa postupu nižšie môžeme jedlo pripraviť v teplovzdušnej fritéze.

c.t: Olej: 1 PL oleja na alobal v koši pri každej dávke a olej v spreji na mäso (ako v zdroji)
Teplovzdušná fritéza: 195 °C, predhriať 3 min; stehná 22–25 min, v polovici obrátiť a postriekať, vnútri 77 °C
Postup:

1. Kuracie mäso naložíme do slaného nálevu a obalíme podľa krokov 1–2, rúru však zohrejeme len na 110 °C (teplovzdušnú na 90 °C), aby sme v nej udržiavali hotové dávky teplé. Alobal vidličkou po celej ploche poprepichujeme, vystelieme ním kôš, pokvapkáme ho 1 PL oleja a fritézu predhrejeme na 195 °C na 3 minúty.
2. Na alobal uložíme dávku stehien kožou nadol, aby neboli natlačené, a zo všetkých strán ich postriekame olejom, kým nie je vidieť suchú múku.
3. Pečieme dozlatista a dochrumkava, kým vnútri nemajú 77 °C, 22–25 minút; v polovici stehná obrátime a znova postriekame. Hotové dávky udržiavame teplé v rúre, kým sa pečú ďalšie (ako v zdroji).
4. Zopakujeme so zvyšnými stehnami, pri každej dávke pridáme na alobal 1 PL oleja, a pred podávaním necháme 10 minút odpočinúť (ako v zdroji).

sk.v: rúra 220 °C (teplovzdušná 200 °C) na mriežke nad vystlaným plechom, asi 1,5–2-násobok času vo fritéze, v polovici obrátiť.

cat.en: Let the coated chicken rest on a rack for 15 minutes before frying; the coating sticks better and stays on in the oil.
cat.sk: Obalené kuracie mäso nechajte pred vyprážaním 15 minút odpočinúť na mriežke; obal lepšie priľne a v oleji neodpadne.

tip.en: An overnight buttermilk brine seasons a few millimetres into the meat, and brined chicken loses about nine percent less moisture when fried. Use lactose-free buttermilk.
tip.sk: Nakladanie cez noc v cmare osolí mäso niekoľko milimetrov do hĺbky a naložené kura stratí pri vyprážaní asi o deväť percent menej šťavy. Použite cmar bez laktózy.

src: America's Test Kitchen — Matthew Card — "Buffalo Wings"

time.en: not given | Cook: not given | Total: not given

en.t: 4 tbsp (56 g) unsalted butter
120 ml hot sauce, preferably Frank's Louisiana Hot Sauce
2 tbsp (30 ml) Tabasco sauce or other hot sauce, plus more to taste
1 tbsp (12 g) dark brown sugar
2 tsp (10 ml) cider vinegar
945 ml–1890 ml peanut oil (or vegetable oil) for frying
1 tsp (5 ml) cayenne pepper
1 tsp (5 ml) ground black pepper
1 tsp (6 g) table salt
3 tbsp (23 g) cornstarch
1360 g chicken wings (18 wings), cut up
71 g blue cheese, crumbled (about 120 ml)
3 tbsp (44 ml) buttermilk
3 tbsp (44 ml) sour cream
2 tbsp (30 ml) mayonnaise
2 tsp (10 ml) white wine vinegar
4 stalks celery, cut into thin sticks
2 medium carrots, peeled and cut into thin slices
1. For the Sauce: Melt butter in small saucepan over low heat. Whisk in hot sauces, brown sugar, and vinegar until combined. Remove from heat and set aside.

2. For the Wings: Preheat oven to 95 °C (fan 75 °C). Line baking sheet with paper towels. Heat 6.5 cm of oil in large Dutch oven over medium-high heat to 180 °C. While oil heats, mix together cayenne, black pepper, salt, and cornstarch in small bowl. Dry chicken with paper towels and place pieces in large mixing bowl. Sprinkle spice mixture over wings and toss with rubber spatula until evenly coated. Fry half of chicken wings until golden and crisp, 10 to 15 minutes. With slotted spoon, transfer fried chicken wings to baking sheet. Keep first batch of chicken warm in oven while frying remaining wings.

3. For the Creamy Blue Cheese Dressing and Vegetables: Mash blue cheese and buttermilk in small bowl with fork until mixture resembles cottage cheese with small curds. Stir in remaining ingredients (up to carrot and celery sticks). Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper. Can be covered and refrigerated up to 4 days.
4. To Serve: Pour sauce mixture into large bowl, add chicken wings, and toss until wings are uniformly coated. Serve immediately with the carrot and celery sticks and blue cheese dressing on side.
5. To Make Ahead: The fried, unsauced wings can be kept warm in the oven for up to 1 1/2 hours. Toss them with the sauce just before serving.

c.t: 1. For the Sauce: Melt butter in small saucepan over low heat. Whisk in hot sauces, brown sugar, and vinegar until combined. Remove from heat and set aside.

2. For the Wings: Preheat oven to 95 °C (fan 75 °C). Line baking sheet with paper towels. Heat 6.5 cm of oil in large Dutch oven over medium-high heat to 180 °C. While oil heats, mix together cayenne, black pepper, salt, and cornstarch in small bowl. Dry chicken with paper towels and place pieces in large mixing bowl. Sprinkle spice mixture over wings and toss with rubber spatula until evenly coated. Fry half of chicken wings until golden and crisp, 10 to 15 minutes. With slotted spoon, transfer fried chicken wings to baking sheet. Keep first batch of chicken warm in oven while frying remaining wings.

3. For the Creamy Blue Cheese Dressing and Vegetables: Mash blue cheese and buttermilk in small bowl with fork until mixture resembles cottage cheese with small curds. Stir in remaining ingredients (up to carrot and celery sticks). Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper. Can be covered and refrigerated up to 4 days.
4. To Serve: Pour sauce mixture into large bowl, add chicken wings, and toss until wings are uniformly coated. Serve immediately with the carrot and celery sticks and blue cheese dressing on side.
5. To Make Ahead: The fried, unsauced wings can be kept warm in the oven for up to 1 1/2 hours. Toss them with the sauce just before serving.
1. **NA OMÁČKU:** V malom kastróliku na miernom ohni rozpustíme maslo. Vmiešame pálivé omáčky, hnedý cukor a ocot, kým sa nespoja. Odstavíme z ohňa a dáme bokom.

2. **NA KRÍDELKÁ:** Rúru predhrejeme na 95 °C (teplovzdušnú na 75 °C). Plech vystelieme papierovými utierkami. Vo veľkom liatinovom hrnci rozohrejeme na stredne silnom až silnom ohni 6,5 cm oleja na 180 °C. Kým sa olej zohrieva, v malej miske zmiešame kajenské korenie, čierne korenie, soľ a kukuričný škrob. Kura osušíme papierovými utierkami a kúsky dáme do veľkej misy. Krídelká posypeme korenistou zmesou a gumenou stierkou premiešame, kým nie sú rovnomerne obalené. Polovicu krídeliek vyprážame dozlatista a dochrumkava, 10 až 15 minút. Cedidlovou naberačkou ich preložíme na plech. Prvú dávku udržiavame v teple v rúre, kým vyprážame zvyšné krídelká.

3. **NA KRÉMOVÝ DRESING S NIVOU A ZELENINU:** V malej miske vidličkou roztlačíme nivu so skysnutým mliekom, kým zmes nepripomína cottage cheese s drobnými hrudkami. Vmiešame zvyšné prísady (až po tyčinky mrkvy a zeler). Ochutnáme a podľa potreby dosolíme a okoreníme. Prikryté vydrží v chladničke až 4 dni.
4. **PODÁVANIE:** Omáčku nalejeme do veľkej misy, pridáme krídelká a premiešame, kým nie sú rovnomerne obalené. Ihneď podávame s tyčinkami mrkvy a zeleru a s dresingom s nivou bokom.
5. **VOPRED:** Vyprážané krídelká bez omáčky môžeme udržiavať teplé v rúre až 1½ hodiny. S omáčkou ich premiešame tesne pred podávaním.

tip.en: Toss the hot cooked wings with lemon zest and herbs instead of a heavy sauce: they get plenty of zing and the skin stays crisp.
tip.sk: Horúce upečené krídelká obaľte v citrónovej kôre a bylinkách namiesto ťažkej omáčky: získajú sviežu chuť a koža zostane chrumkavá.

tip.en: Toss the wings in cornstarch mixed with the barbecue spices before grilling; it helps the skin crisp.
tip.sk: Pred grilovaním obaľte krídelká v kukuričnom škrobe zmiešanom s grilovacím korením; koža bude chrumkavejšia.

c.t: Clarified butter gives the best flavour but takes more work and costs more; oil is absolutely fine and saves time and money.
Prepustené maslo dá najlepšiu chuť, ale je s ním viac práce a je drahšie; olej je úplne v poriadku a ušetrí čas aj peniaze.

en.t: 140 g all-purpose flour
3 large eggs, beaten
60 g panko bread crumbs, roughly crushed by hand if very large
30 g grated Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese
2 boneless, skinless chicken breast halves (140–200 g each), cut into 4 cutlets and pounded to about 0.5 cm thick each
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
Freshly ground black pepper
Clarified butter or vegetable oil, for frying (about 235–355 ml)
5-Minute Radicchio and Watercress Salad (optional)
Lemon wedges, for serving (optional)
1. Set 3 wide, shallow bowls on a work surface. Add flour to the first one, beaten eggs to the second, and panko and Parmesan cheese to the third. Mix panko and Parmesan thoroughly.

2. Season both sides of chicken cutlets with salt and pepper. Working with one at a time, dredge a cutlet in flour with your left hand, shaking off excess. Transfer to egg dish, then turn cutlet with your right hand to coat both sides. Lift and allow excess egg to drain off, then transfer to bread crumb mixture. With your left hand, scoop bread crumbs on top of chicken, then gently press, turning chicken to ensure a good layer of crumbs on both sides. Transfer cutlet to a clean plate and repeat with remaining cutlets.

3. Fill a large cast iron skillet with 0.5 cm clarified butter or frying oil. (To speed things up even more, use 2 skillets simultaneously.) Heat cooking fat over high heat until shimmering and just shy of smoking, about 190 °C on an instant-read thermometer.

4. Using tongs or your fingers, gently lower cutlets into the hot fat, laying them down away from you to prevent hot fat from splashing toward you. (Work in batches if necessary.) Fry, gently swirling pan and rotating cutlets for even browning, and adjust heat as necessary for a steady, vigorous bubble, until the bottom side of cutlet is browned and crisp, 2 1/2 to 3 minutes. Flip cutlets and fry until other side is browned and crisp, 2 1/2 to 3 minutes longer. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate or baking dish and season with salt right away. Repeat with remaining cutlets. Serve immediately with 5-minute radicchio and watercress salad and lemon wedges on the side, if desired.

1. Na pracovnú plochu postavíme 3 široké plytké misy. Do prvej dáme múku, do druhej rozšľahané vajcia a do tretej panko s parmezánom. Panko s parmezánom dôkladne premiešame.

2. Kuracie rezne z oboch strán osolíme a okoreníme. Po jednom ich ľavou rukou obalíme v múke a prebytok otrasieme. Preložíme do misy s vajcom a pravou rukou rezeň obrátime, aby bol obalený z oboch strán. Zdvihneme, necháme prebytočné vajce odkvapkať a preložíme do strúhankovej zmesi. Ľavou rukou nasypeme strúhanku aj na vrch, jemne pritlačíme a rezeň obraciame, aby mal z oboch strán poriadnu vrstvu strúhanky. Preložíme na čistý tanier a postup zopakujeme so zvyšnými rezňami.

3. Do veľkej liatinovej panvice nalejeme 0,5 cm prepusteného masla alebo oleja na vyprážanie. (Aby to išlo ešte rýchlejšie, môžeme používať 2 panvice naraz.) Tuk rozohrejeme na silnom ohni, kým sa neleskne a takmer nedymí, asi na 190 °C podľa vpichového teplomera.

4. Kliešťami alebo prstami rezne opatrne vkladáme do horúceho tuku, smerom od seba, aby horúci tuk nešpliechal na nás. (Ak treba, vyprážame po dávkach.) Vyprážame, panvicou jemne krúžime a rezne otáčame, aby rovnomerne zhnedli; oheň upravujeme tak, aby tuk stále živo bublal, kým spodná strana rezňa nie je zhnednutá a chrumkavá, 2½ až 3 minúty. Rezne obrátime a vyprážame, kým aj druhá strana nie je zhnednutá a chrumkavá, ďalšie 2½ až 3 minúty. Preložíme na tanier alebo do misy vystlanej papierovými utierkami a hneď osolíme. Postup zopakujeme so zvyšnými rezňami. Ihneď podávame, ak chceme, s 5-minútovým šalátom z radicchia a žeruchy a s mesiačikmi citróna bokom.

en.t: 1. **CUT AND BRINE:**

2. Following photos, cut each chicken breast diagonally into thirds, then cut each third diagonally into 1.5 cm-thick pieces. Whisk water, 1 tbsp salt, and Worcestershire in large bowl until salt dissolves. Add chicken pieces and refrigerate, covered, for 30 minutes.
3. **COAT CHICKEN:**

4. Remove chicken from brine, discard brine, and pat chicken dry with paper towels. Combine flour, bread crumbs, onion powder, remaining salt, pepper, garlic powder, and baking soda in shallow dish. Whisk egg whites in second shallow dish until foamy. Coat half of chicken with egg whites and dredge in flour-crumb mixture, pressing gently to adhere. Transfer to plate and repeat with remaining chicken (don’t discard flour-crumb mixture). Let sit 10 minutes.

5. FRY: Adjust oven rack to middle position and heat oven to 95 °C (fan 75 °C). Heat oil in large Dutch oven over medium-high heat to 175 °C. Return chicken to flour dish and turn to coat, pressing flour-crumb mixture gently to adhere. Fry half of chicken until deep golden brown, about 3 minutes, turning halfway through cooking. Drain chicken on wire rack set inside rimmed baking sheet and place in oven. Return oil to 175 °C and repeat with remaining chicken. Serve with dipping sauces. TO MAKE AHEAD: Cool fried nuggets, transfer to zipper-lock bag, and freeze for up to 1 month. To serve, adjust oven rack to middle position and heat oven to 175 °C (fan 155 °C). Place nuggets on rimmed baking sheet and bake, flipping once, until heated through, about 15 minutes.

sk.t: 1. **NAREZANIE A NÁLEV:**

2. Podľa fotografií nakrájame každé kuracie prsia šikmo na tretiny a každú tretinu šikmo na kúsky hrubé 1,5 cm. Vo veľkej mise vyšľaháme vodu, 1 PL soli a worcesterovú omáčku, kým sa soľ nerozpustí. Pridáme kúsky kuraťa a prikryté dáme na 30 minút do chladničky.
3. **OBALENIE:**

4. Kura vyberieme z nálevu, nálev vylejeme a mäso osušíme papierovými utierkami. V plytkej mise zmiešame múku, strúhanku, cibuľový prášok, zvyšnú soľ, korenie, cesnakový prášok a jedlú sódu. V druhej plytkej mise vyšľaháme bielky do peny. Polovicu kuraťa obalíme v bielkoch a potom v múčno-strúhankovej zmesi, jemne pritlačíme, aby priľnula. Preložíme na tanier a zopakujeme so zvyšným kuraťom (múčno-strúhankovú zmes nevyhadzujeme). Necháme 10 minút postáť.

5. **VYPRÁŽANIE:** Rošt nastavíme do stredu rúry a rúru rozohrejeme na 95 °C (teplovzdušnú na 75 °C). Vo veľkom liatinovom hrnci rozohrejeme na stredne silnom až silnom ohni olej na 175 °C. Kura vrátime do misy s múkou a obrátime, aby sa obalilo, múčno-strúhankovú zmes jemne pritlačíme. Polovicu kuraťa vyprážame dosýta zlatohneda, asi 3 minúty, v polovici vyprážania obrátime. Kura necháme odkvapkať na mriežke vloženej do plechu s okrajom a dáme do rúry. Olej opäť zohrejeme na 175 °C a zopakujeme so zvyšným kuraťom. Podávame s omáčkami na namáčanie. **VOPRED:** Vyprážané nugety necháme vychladnúť, preložíme do uzatvárateľného vrecka a zmrazíme najviac na 1 mesiac. Pred podávaním nastavíme rošt do stredu rúry a rúru rozohrejeme na 175 °C (teplovzdušnú na 155 °C). Nugety rozložíme na plech s okrajom a pečieme, raz obrátime, kým sa neprehrejú, asi 15 minút.

c.t: Oil: a light coat of oil spray on the basket, sprayed again before each batch (as in the source)
Air fryer: 204 °C, 10–12 min per batch, tossing halfway, to 71 °C inside
Steps:
1. Brine and coat the chicken as in steps 2–4. Heat the oven to 95 °C (fan 75 °C) to keep the nuggets warm.
2. Lightly spray the base of the basket with oil and add a batch of nuggets in a single layer.
3. Air-fry at 204 °C until golden and 71 °C inside, 10–12 minutes, tossing them halfway. Keep warm in the oven, spray the basket again and cook the remaining nuggets.

c.t: Olej: tenká vrstva oleja v spreji na kôš, pred každou dávkou znova (ako v zdroji)
Teplovzdušná fritéza: 204 °C, 10–12 min na dávku, v polovici premiešať, vnútri 71 °C
Postup:
1. Kuracie mäso naložíme do slaného nálevu a obalíme podľa krokov 2–4. Rúru zohrejeme na 95 °C (teplovzdušnú na 75 °C), aby sme v nej mohli udržiavať nugetky teplé.
2. Dno koša zľahka postriekame olejom a vložíme dávku nugetiek v jednej vrstve.

c.t: Use any combination of breasts and/or legs, or a whole chicken cut into pieces. In Jamaica the pieces are usually chopped through the bone into smaller pieces; at the least, separate drumsticks and thighs at the joint and cut the breast into 2 pieces, one with the wing attached.
Ground cumin, coriander seed and garam masala are added to the Jamaican curry powder for extra depth; they are not required (many Jamaican cooks would not add them), so omit them if you like.
Potatoes and carrots are added by some cooks in Jamaica and not by others; they are optional.
Coconut milk is not in many Jamaican curry chicken recipes, but it makes a delicate yet rich gravy with deeper flavour.

Použite ľubovoľnú kombináciu pŕs a/alebo stehien alebo celé kurča rozporciované na kusy. Na Jamajke sa kusy zvyčajne sekajú aj s kosťou na menšie kúsky; minimálne oddeľte paličky od horných stehien v kĺbe a prsia rozdeľte na 2 kusy, jeden s krídlom.
Mletá rasca rímska, koriandrové semienko a garam masala sa pridávajú k jamajskému kari kvôli plnšej chuti; nie sú nutné (mnohí jamajskí kuchári ich nepridávajú), takže ich pokojne vynechajte.
Zemiaky a mrkvu niektorí kuchári na Jamajke pridávajú a iní nie; sú nepovinné.
Kokosové mlieko nie je v mnohých jamajských receptoch na kuracie kari, ale vytvorí jemnú, a pritom bohatú omáčku s plnšou chuťou.

1. For the Marinated Chicken: Rub chicken all over with lime (or lemon), then season all over with salt and pepper.

2. In a medium bowl, stir together turmeric, garlic, minced Scotch bonnet, curry powder, ground allspice, ginger, and thyme leaves. Add chicken pieces and, using gloved hands, massage the spice marinade all over chicken, including under the skin. Cover chicken and marinate, refrigerated, for at least 1 and up to 12 hours.

3. For the Curry: In large heavy-bottomed pot or Dutch oven, warm 2 tbsp (30 ml) oil over medium heat until shimmering. Working in batches if necessary to avoid crowding the pot, add chicken pieces and cook, turning often, until lightly browned on both sides, about 5 minutes; be careful not to let the marinated chicken get too dark. Transfer chicken to a platter and set aside.
4. Add remaining 2 tbsp (30 ml) oil to pot. Add curry powder, ginger, cumin, coriander seeds, and garam masala (if using), and cook, stirring, until lightly toasted, about 1 minute.
5. Stir in onion, carrots, and potato (if using). Cook, until just starting to soften, about 5 minutes.

6. Add chicken back to pot along with any accumulated juices and stir to coat with aromatics and spices. Add 227 ml hot water, thyme sprigs, whole Scotch bonnet, and allspice berries and bring to a boil. Cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer 30 minutes.

7. Uncover and add 113 ml coconut milk, then continue to simmer, uncovered, until the sauce forms a rich, gravy-like consistency, about 15 minutes. If needed, add more water and/or coconut milk to thin an over-reduced sauce. Season with salt and pepper.
8. We like to serve this with jasmine or basmati rice, mango or papaya chutney, fried ripe plantains, and sliced avocado.

1. **NA MARINOVANÉ KURA:** Kura zo všetkých strán potrieme limetkou (alebo citrónom), potom zo všetkých strán osolíme a okoreníme.

2. V stredne veľkej mise zmiešame kurkumu, cesnak, nasekanú papričku scotch bonnet, karí, mleté nové korenie, zázvor a lístky tymiánu. Pridáme kúsky kuraťa a rukami v rukaviciach korenistú marinádu vmasírujeme do celého kuraťa, aj pod kožu. Kura prikryjeme a necháme marinovať v chladničke aspoň 1 a najviac 12 hodín.

3. **NA KARI:** Vo veľkom hrnci s hrubým dnom alebo v liatinovom hrnci rozohrejeme na strednom ohni 1¼ PL (18 ml) oleja, kým sa neleskne. Ak treba, pracujeme po dávkach, aby sme hrniec nepreplnili: pridáme kúsky kuraťa a za častého obracania ich opekáme, kým z oboch strán zľahka nezhnednú, asi 5 minút; dávame pozor, aby marinované kura príliš nestmavlo. Kura preložíme na tácku a dáme bokom.

4. Do hrnca pridáme zvyšné 1¼ PL (18 ml) oleja. Pridáme karí, zázvor, rímsku rascu (kmín), koriandrové semienka a garam masalu (ak ju používame) a za miešania opekáme, kým sa zľahka neopražia, asi 1 minútu.
5. Vmiešame cibuľu, mrkvu a zemiak (ak ho používame). Dusíme, kým nezačnú mäknúť, asi 5 minút.

6. Kura vrátime do hrnca spolu s vytečenou šťavou a premiešame, aby sa obalilo aromatickými prísadami a koreninami. Pridáme 227 ml horúcej vody, vetvičky tymiánu, celú papričku scotch bonnet a celé nové korenie a privedieme do varu. Prikryjeme, stlmíme na mierny oheň a dusíme 30 minút.

en.t: 1. In a large saucepan, combine water and salt, stirring to dissolve salt. Add chicken and aromatics and set over medium-high heat until water temperature reaches between 65 and 70 °C on an instant-read thermometer; adjust heat to maintain water temperature in the 65–70 °C range. Cook until thickest part of chicken registers 65 °C on an instant-read thermometer, about 30 minutes to 1 hour (timing is difficult to estimate as it is heavily influenced by both the temperature at which you're able to hold the poaching liquid and also the size of the chicken breast used). 2. Refrigerate chicken either submerged in cooled broth or the two components separately in airtight containers until ready to use as desired.

en.t: 1 tbsp (15 ml) extra-virgin olive oil
454 g boneless, skinless chicken breasts or thighs, cut into 2.5 cm pieces
4 tbsp (56 g) unsalted butter
3 small carrots (about 57 g each), peeled and chopped
2 celery ribs (about 68 g each) chopped
1 medium leek, washed and rinsed of any grit, sliced
3 medium cloves garlic (15 g), chopped
2 tsp (10 ml) chopped fresh thyme, plus more for garnish
2 tsp (6 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt, use half as much by volume
1/4 tsp (1.2 ml) cayenne pepper
44 g all-purpose flour
480 ml chicken broth, homemade or store-bought
65 ml heavy cream, divided
175 g frozen sweet green peas
2 tsp (10 ml) lemon zest, finely grated from 1 lemon
1 sheet puff pastry (490 g) from 1 package frozen puff pastry, thawed
1 egg

1. Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 205 °C (fan 185 °C). Heat oil in a 25 cm cast iron skillet over medium heat until just shimmering. Add chicken; cook, stirring occasionally, until cooked through, about 6 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, remove chicken from skillet, and transfer to a plate.

2. Melt butter in same skillet over medium. Stir in carrots, celery, leek, garlic, thyme, salt, and cayenne; cook, stirring often, until vegetables are tender, about 6 minutes. Sprinkle with flour; cook, stirring constantly, until vegetables are evenly coated and flour begins to stick to bottom of skillet, about 1 minute. Stir in broth and 59 ml of the cream; bring to a simmer over medium heat and cook, stirring often, until mixture thickens, about 3 minutes. Stir in peas, lemon zest, and reserved chicken; remove from heat.
3. Place puff pastry on top of chicken mixture in skillet; tuck edges inside skillet so mixture is covered completely.

4. In a small bowl, whisk together egg and remaining 1 tsp (5 ml) heavy cream. Using a pastry brush, brush top of pastry with egg wash. Using a sharp paring knife, cut an “X” about 7.5 cm across in middle of pastry. (This allows steam to escape as the pie bakes.)
5. Set skillet on top of a rimmed baking sheet and bake until top is golden brown and filling is bubbly, about 30 minutes. Remove from oven and let stand 10 minutes before serving.

en.t: 1 tbsp (15 ml) canola oil or other neutral oil
4 bone-in, skin-on chicken legs, separated into thighs and drumsticks (about 1150 g)
Kosher salt
8 garlic cloves, thinly sliced
2 whole fresh bay leaves (or 3 whole dried bay leaves)
1 1/2 tsp (7.5 ml) whole black peppercorns
300 ml water
240 ml soy sauce
240 ml rice vinegar
Steamed white rice or garlic fried rice, for serving
1. In a heavy-bottomed pot or Dutch oven, heat oil over medium heat until shimmering. Blot chicken dry with paper towels, then season lightly all over with salt.

2. Working in batches if necessary, add chicken pieces to pot in a single layer, skin side down, making sure not to overcrowd the pot. Cook until well browned, 6 to 7 minutes. Using tongs, flip chicken pieces and cook until lightly brown on the second side, about 3 minutes. Transfer chicken to a plate and set aside.

3. Add garlic, bay leaves, and peppercorns to now-empty pot and cook, stirring constantly, until mixture is very fragrant and garlic turns a light golden color, about 30 seconds. Add water and stir with a wooden spoon, scraping up any brown bits on the bottom of the pot. Add soy sauce and vinegar, return chicken pieces to pot, increase heat to high, and bring liquid to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until chicken is cooked through and tender, about 20 minutes, turning the chicken pieces halfway through.

4. To Serve: The chicken is best served after sitting overnight in the refrigerator, but it can also be served immediately, with steamed white rice or (preferably) garlic fried rice. The chicken pieces can also be briefly broiled before serving.

5. To Broil Chicken Adobo: Adjust oven rack to 15 cm below broiler element and preheat broiler to high. Transfer chicken pieces to a paper towel–lined rimmed baking sheet and blot surface with more paper towels to remove as much moisture as possible; discard paper towels. Arrange chicken skin side up on the baking sheet and broil until chicken skin is crispy and lightly charred, about 2 minutes (keep an eye on the chicken to ensure it does not burn). Serve immediately with steamed white rice or (preferably) garlic fried rice, passing adobo sauce at the table.

c.t: 1. In a heavy-bottomed pot or Dutch oven, heat oil over medium heat until shimmering. Blot chicken dry with paper towels, then season lightly all over with salt.

2. Working in batches if necessary, add chicken pieces to pot in a single layer, skin side down, making sure not to overcrowd the pot. Cook until well browned, 6 to 7 minutes. Using tongs, flip chicken pieces and cook until lightly brown on the second side, about 3 minutes. Transfer chicken to a plate and set aside.

3. Add garlic, bay leaves, and peppercorns to now-empty pot and cook, stirring constantly, until mixture is very fragrant and garlic turns a light golden color, about 30 seconds. Add water and stir with a wooden spoon, scraping up any brown bits on the bottom of the pot. Add soy sauce and vinegar, return chicken pieces to pot, increase heat to high, and bring liquid to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until chicken is cooked through and tender, about 20 minutes, turning the chicken pieces halfway through.

4. To Serve: The chicken is best served after sitting overnight in the refrigerator, but it can also be served immediately, with steamed white rice or (preferably) garlic fried rice. The chicken pieces can also be briefly broiled before serving.

5. To Broil Chicken Adobo: Adjust oven rack to 15 cm below broiler element and preheat broiler to high. Transfer chicken pieces to a paper towel–lined rimmed baking sheet and blot surface with more paper towels to remove as much moisture as possible; discard paper towels. Arrange chicken skin side up on the baking sheet and broil until chicken skin is crispy and lightly charred, about 2 minutes (keep an eye on the chicken to ensure it does not burn). Serve immediately with steamed white rice or (preferably) garlic fried rice, passing adobo sauce at the table.
1. V hrnci s hrubým dnom alebo v liatinovom hrnci rozohrejeme na strednom ohni olej, kým sa neleskne. Kura osušíme papierovými utierkami a potom ho zo všetkých strán zľahka osolíme.

2. Ak treba, pracujeme po dávkach: kúsky kuraťa vložíme do hrnca v jednej vrstve kožou nadol a dbáme, aby sme hrniec nepreplnili. Opekáme, kým pekne nezhnednú, 6 až 7 minút. Kliešťami kúsky obrátime a opekáme, kým aj druhá strana zľahka nezhnedne, asi 3 minúty. Kura preložíme na tanier a dáme bokom.

3. Do prázdneho hrnca dáme cesnak, bobkové listy a celé korenie a za stáleho miešania opekáme, kým zmes intenzívne nevonia a cesnak nie je svetlozlatý, asi 30 sekúnd. Pridáme vodu a drevenou varechou zoškrabeme zo dna hrnca pripečené zvyšky. Pridáme sójovú omáčku a ocot, kúsky kuraťa vrátime do hrnca, zvýšime na silný oheň a tekutinu privedieme do varu. Stlmíme na mierny oheň, prikryjeme a dusíme, kým kura nie je prepečené a mäkké, asi 20 minút; v polovici času kúsky obrátime.

4. **PODÁVANIE:** Kura je najlepšie, keď cez noc postojí v chladničke, ale môžeme ho podávať aj hneď, s dusenou bielou ryžou alebo (najlepšie) s cesnakovou vyprážanou ryžou. Kúsky kuraťa môžeme pred podávaním aj krátko zapiecť pod grilom.

5. **ZAPEČENIE ADOBA POD GRILOM:** Rošt nastavíme 15 cm pod grilovacie teleso a gril v rúre predhrejeme na najvyšší stupeň. Kúsky kuraťa preložíme na plech s okrajom vystlaný papierovými utierkami a povrch osušíme ďalšími utierkami, aby sme odstránili čo najviac vlhkosti; utierky vyhodíme. Kura poukladáme na plech kožou nahor a zapekáme pod grilom, kým koža nie je chrumkavá a miestami zľahka opálená, asi 2 minúty (kura sledujeme, aby sa nepripálilo). Ihneď podávame s dusenou bielou ryžou alebo (najlepšie) s cesnakovou vyprážanou ryžou a adobo omáčku podávame pri stole.

cat.en: Chicken adobo improves immensely after a night in the refrigerator, as the cooked vinegar mellows over time.

en.t: 79 ml plain whole-milk yogurt
40 fresh curry leaves (20 chopped fine, 20 whole)
8-10 garlic cloves, minced to paste (2 tbsp (30 ml)), plus 2 thinly sliced garlic cloves
2 tbsp (30 ml) grated fresh ginger
1½ tbsp (22 ml) garam masala
3 tbsp (44 ml) lemon juice, divided
2½ tsp (12 ml) Kashmiri chile powder, divided
1½ tsp (9 g) table salt
1 tsp (5 ml) ground turmeric
680 g boneless, skinless chicken breasts, trimmed and cut into 4 cm pieces
3 tbsp (44 ml) vegetable oil
6 Thai chiles, stemmed
½ tsp (2 g) sugar
2840 ml peanut or vegetable oil for frying
56 g cornstarch
60 g white rice flour
120 ml water

1. Whisk yogurt, chopped curry leaves, minced garlic, ginger, garam masala, 1 tbsp (15 ml) lemon juice, 1½ tsp (7.5 ml) chile powder, salt, and turmeric together in large bowl. Stir in chicken, cover, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 16 hours.

2. Heat vegetable oil in small saucepan over medium heat until shimmering. Add Thai chiles and cook until skins are blistered, 1½ to 2 minutes. Add whole curry leaves and thinly sliced garlic and cook until leaves turn crisp but garlic is not browned, about 1 minute (curry leaves will sputter). Remove from heat. Swirling saucepan gently, add sugar, remaining 2 tbsp (30 ml) lemon juice, and remaining 1 tsp (5 ml) chile powder, swirling until sugar is dissolved; set glaze aside.

3. Adjust oven rack to middle position and heat oven to 95 °C (fan 75 °C). Set wire rack in rimmed baking sheet and line with triple layer of paper towels. Add peanut oil to large Dutch oven and heat over medium-high heat to 165 °C. While oil heats, whisk cornstarch, flour, and water together in bowl until smooth. Add to marinated chicken–yogurt mixture, stirring to coat chicken well.

4. Add one-third of chicken, one piece at a time, to oil and fry until golden brown and cooked through, 4 to 5 minutes, stirring to separate pieces as needed. Using spider skimmer or slotted spoon, transfer chicken to prepared sheet and transfer to oven to keep warm. Return oil to 165 °C and repeat with remaining chicken in 2 more batches.
5. Transfer chicken to large bowl and add glaze. Toss gently to coat and serve immediately.

1. Vo veľkej mise vyšľaháme jogurt, nasekané karí listy, nasekaný cesnak, zázvor, garam masalu, 1 PL (15 ml) citrónovej šťavy, 1½ ČL (7,5 ml) čili prášku, soľ a kurkumu. Vmiešame kura, prikryjeme a dáme do chladničky aspoň na 30 minút a najviac na 16 hodín.

2. V malom kastróliku rozohrejeme na strednom ohni rastlinný olej, kým sa neleskne. Pridáme thajské čili papričky a opekáme, kým sa šupky nespľuzgierujú, 1½ až 2 minúty. Pridáme celé karí listy a na tenko nakrájaný cesnak a opekáme, kým listy nie sú chrumkavé, ale cesnak ešte nezhnedol, asi 1 minútu (karí listy budú prskať). Odstavíme z ohňa. Kastrólikom jemne krúžime, pridáme cukor, zvyšné 2 PL (30 ml) citrónovej šťavy a zvyšnú 1 ČL (5 ml) čili prášku a krúžime, kým sa cukor nerozpustí; glazúru dáme bokom.

3. Rošt nastavíme do stredu rúry a rúru rozohrejeme na 95 °C (teplovzdušnú na 75 °C). Do plechu s okrajom vložíme mriežku a vystelieme ju trojitou vrstvou papierových utierok. Do veľkého liatinového hrnca nalejeme arašidový olej a na stredne silnom až silnom ohni ho rozohrejeme na 165 °C. Kým sa olej zohrieva, v mise vyšľaháme kukuričný škrob, múku a vodu dohladka. Pridáme k marinovanej zmesi kuraťa s jogurtom a premiešame, aby sa kura dobre obalilo.

4. Do oleja po kúsku pridáme tretinu kuraťa a vyprážame dozlatista a doprepečenia, 4 až 5 minút; podľa potreby premiešame, aby sa kúsky oddelili. Cedidlovou naberačkou kura preložíme na pripravený plech a dáme do rúry, aby zostalo teplé. Olej opäť zohrejeme na 165 °C a zvyšné kura vyprážame v ďalších 2 dávkach.
5. Kura preložíme do veľkej misy a pridáme glazúru. Jemne premiešame, aby sa obalilo, a ihneď podávame.

en.v: instead of frying as in the method below, the dish can be made in the air fryer.

c.t: Oil: 1–2 tbsp oil, sprayed or brushed on (instead of the frying oil)
Air fryer: 200 °C, 12–15 min, shaking halfway, to at least 74 °C inside (preheat 3 min; don't crowd the basket — cook in batches)
Steps:
1. Marinate the chicken and make the glaze as in steps 1–2. Instead of the wet batter, toss the chicken with the cornstarch and rice flour only (no water) until evenly coated.
2. Spray the pieces all over with oil and lay them in the basket in a single layer.
3. Air-fry until golden and crisp and at least 74 °C inside, 12–15 minutes, shaking the basket halfway. Toss with the glaze as in step 5 and serve immediately.

1. Kuracie mäso marinujeme a glazúru pripravíme podľa krokov 1–2. Namiesto riedkeho cestíčka mäso obalíme iba v kukuričnom škrobe a ryžovej múke (bez vody), kým nie je rovnomerne obalené.

3. Pečieme dozlatista a dochrumkava, kým vnútri nemajú aspoň 74 °C, 12–15 minút; v polovici kôš pretrasieme. Premiešame s glazúrou podľa kroku 5 a hneď podávame.

en.v: You can prepare the annatto oil, without the salt and calamansi juice, ahead of time and keep it refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 3 months. Before using, melt oil over medium-low heat then let cool to room temperature. Once cool, whisk in salt and lemon or calamansi juice. The marinade, without the lemon-lime soda, can be prepared ahead of time and refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 1 week. Whisk in soda right before marinating chicken. Leftover chicken inasal can be refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

sk.v: Annatový olej (bez soli a šťavy z calamansi) môžeme pripraviť vopred a uchovávať v chladničke v uzatvárateľnej nádobe až 3 mesiace. Pred použitím olej rozpustíme na stredne miernom ohni a necháme vychladnúť na izbovú teplotu. Po vychladnutí zašľaháme soľ a citrónovú šťavu alebo šťavu z calamansi. Marinádu (bez citrónovo-limetkovej limonády) môžeme pripraviť vopred a uchovávať v chladničke v uzatvárateľnej nádobe až 1 týždeň. Limonádu primiešame tesne pred marinovaním kuraťa. Zvyšky kuracieho inasal môžeme uchovávať v chladničke v uzatvárateľnej nádobe až 3 dni.

c.t: Calamansi is hard to find fresh; frozen calamansi juice from an Asian or Filipino market tastes better than bottled. Without calamansi, mix 1 part fresh lemon juice, 1/2 part fresh lime juice and 1/4 part granulated sugar (by volume).
Light or dark brown sugar can replace the dark muscovado sugar.
Vegetable or canola oil, or schmaltz, can be used instead of coconut oil.
Spiced coconut vinegar (sinamak; the extra-spicy version is sold as pinakurat) is sold in Asian markets and online. Cane vinegar or distilled white vinegar are acceptable substitutes.

Čerstvé kalamansi sa ťažko zháňa; mrazená kalamansiová šťava z ázijského alebo filipínskeho obchodu chutí lepšie ako fľašková. Bez kalamansi zmiešajte 1 diel čerstvej citrónovej šťavy, 1/2 dielu čerstvej limetkovej šťavy a 1/4 dielu kryštálového cukru (podľa objemu).
Tmavý muscovado cukor môžete nahradiť svetlým alebo tmavým hnedým cukrom.
Namiesto kokosového oleja môžete použiť rastlinný alebo repkový olej, prípadne kurciu masť (schmaltz).
Korenený kokosový ocot (sinamak; extra pálivá verzia sa predáva ako pinakurat) dostanete v ázijských obchodoch a online. Ako náhrada poslúži trstinový ocot alebo biely destilovaný ocot.

en.t: coconut vinegar
120 ml fresh lemon juice (from 3 to 4 lemons) or calamansi juice
60 ml Maggi seasoning
115 g packed dark muscovado sugar
120 ml lemon-lime soda, such as Sprite
3 stalks lemongrass, bottom 10–13 cm only, outer leaves discarded, tender core finely chopped (about 50 g)
One 5 cm knob peeled fresh ginger (25 g), grated
8 medium garlic cloves (40 g), minced
1 tbsp (9 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; if using table salt, use half as much by volume or the same weight
1 1/2 tsp (7.5 ml) freshly ground black pepper
1400 g bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs or leg quarters
2 tbsp (20 g) annatto seeds
235 ml refined coconut oil
1 tsp (3 g) Diamond Crystal kosher salt; if using table salt, use half as much by volume or the same weight
1 tbsp (5 ml) fresh lemon juice (from 1 lemon) or calamansi juice
120 ml sinamak (spiced coconut vinegar)
120 ml fresh lemon juice (from 3 to 4 lemons) or calamansi juice, optional
120 ml soy sauce, optional
1 to 2 fresh Thai chiles, stemmed, whole or roughly chopped (optional)
1 scallion, ends trimmed and sliced thinly on a bias, for garnish
1 tbsp (6 g) homemade or store-bought fried garlic, for garnish
Cooked white rice or garlic fried rice

1. For the Marinated Chicken: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together coconut vinegar, lemon or calamansi juice, Maggi seasoning, muscovado sugar, lemon-lime soda, lemongrass, ginger, garlic, salt, and black pepper until sugar and salt are completely dissolved, about 1 minute. Set aside.

2. Using a sharp knife, make two 2.5 cm long slits, about 0.5 cm deep, across the skin of each chicken thigh. Flip chicken over, and, using the tines of a fork, poke holes all over the underside of each piece. Add chicken to the marinade and, using your hands, toss to thoroughly coat. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 6 hours or up to 8 hours.

3. For the Annatto Oil: In a small pot, heat coconut oil and annatto seeds over medium-low heat until the oil turns bright orange-red, about 10 minutes. Strain oil through a fine mesh strainer set over a medium heatproof bowl, discarding seeds. Let oil cool to room temperature. Once cool, whisk in salt and lemon or calamansi juice and set aside.
4. For the Sawsawan Dipping Sauce: In a medium bowl, whisk together sinamak, lemon juice or calamansi juice (if using), soy sauce (if using), and chiles (if using) until combined and set aside.

5. To Grill: Light one chimney full of charcoal. When all the charcoal is lit and covered with gray ash, pour out and spread the coals evenly over half of coal grate. Set cooking grate in place, cover grill and allow to preheat for 5 minutes. Alternatively, set half the burners of a gas grill to the highest heat setting, cover, and preheat for 10 minutes. Clean and oil grilling grate.

6. Remove chicken from marinade, allow excess marinade to drip off, and transfer to a rimmed baking sheet; discard marinade. Brush chicken all over with annatto oil, then place chicken skin side up on cooler side of grill. 2. Using a sharp knife, make two 2.5 cm long slits, about 0.5 cm deep, across the skin of each chicken thigh. Flip chicken over, and, using the tines of a fork, poke holes all over the underside of each piece. Add chicken to the marinade and, using your hands, toss to thoroughly coat. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 6 hours or up to 8 hours.

3. For the Annatto Oil: In a small pot, heat coconut oil and annatto seeds over medium-low heat until the oil turns bright orange-red, about 10 minutes. Strain oil through a fine mesh strainer set over a medium heatproof bowl, discarding seeds. Let oil cool to room temperature. Once cool, whisk in salt and lemon or calamansi juice and set aside.
4. For the Sawsawan Dipping Sauce: In a medium bowl, whisk together sinamak, lemon juice or calamansi juice (if using), soy sauce (if using), and chiles (if using) until combined and set aside.

5. To Grill: Light one chimney full of charcoal. When all the charcoal is lit and covered with gray ash, pour out and spread the coals evenly over half of coal grate. Set cooking grate in place, cover grill and allow to preheat for 5 minutes. Alternatively, set half the burners of a gas grill to the highest heat setting, cover, and preheat for 10 minutes. Clean and oil grilling grate.

6. Remove chicken from marinade, allow excess marinade to drip off, and transfer to a rimmed baking sheet; discard marinade. Brush chicken all over with annatto oil, then place chicken skin side up on cooler side of grill. Cover grill (if using a charcoal grill, open vents on lid, aligned over chicken, and open bottom vents) and cook for 5 minutes. Flip chicken, brush all over with annatto oil, cover, and cook for 5 minutes. Continue to cook chicken, flipping and brushing with annatto oil every 5 minutes, until an instant-read thermometer inserted into thickest part of the thigh registers 60 °C, about 20 minutes total.

Cover and cook until skin is crisp and an instant-read thermometer inserted into thickest part of thigh registers 74 °C, about 5 minutes longer; only lift lid long enough to take the temperature, as the extra oxygen can encourage flare-ups and burning. If chicken threatens to burn before internal temperature is achieved, transfer to the cooler side of the grill, cover, and continue to cook until done. Transfer chicken to a wire rack set over a rimmed baking sheet and let rest for 5 minutes.

8. To Use the Oven/Stovetop: Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat to 218 °C (fan 198 °C). Line a rimmed baking sheet with aluminum foil and place a wire rack on top. Remove chicken from marinade, allow excess marinade to drip off, and set chicken skin side down on prepared wire rack; discard marinade. Continue to cook chicken, flipping and brushing with annatto, until lightly browned and an instant-read thermometer inserted into thickest part of thigh registers 74 °C, about 10 minutes longer. Remove chicken from oven, brush both sides with annatto oil, and set aside.

9. Heat a cast iron skillet or grill pan over high heat until lightly smoking. Rub skillet lightly with oil, then sear chicken skin side down until lightly charred, about 3 minutes. Transfer chicken to a wire rack set over rimmed baking sheet and let rest 5 minutes.

1. **NA MARINOVANÉ KURA:** Vo veľkej mise vyšľaháme kokosový ocot, citrónovú alebo kalamansiovú šťavu, korenie Maggi, muscovado cukor, citrónovo-limetkovú limonádu, citrónovú trávu, zázvor, cesnak, soľ a čierne korenie, kým sa cukor a soľ úplne nerozpustia, asi 1 minútu. Dáme bokom.

2. Ostrým nožom urobíme do kože každého kuracieho stehna dva zárezy dlhé 2,5 cm a hlboké asi 0,5 cm. Kura obrátime a hrotmi vidličky popichneme celú spodnú stranu každého kúska. Kura vložíme do marinády a rukami premiešame, aby sa dôkladne obalilo. Pevne prikryjeme potravinovou fóliou a dáme do chladničky aspoň na 6 a najviac na 8 hodín.

3. **NA ANNATTOVÝ OLEJ:** V malom hrnci zohrievame na miernom až strednom ohni kokosový olej so semienkami annatta, kým olej nie je žiarivo oranžovočervený, asi 10 minút. Olej precedíme cez jemné sitko do stredne veľkej žiaruvzdornej misy a semienka vyhodíme. Necháme vychladnúť na izbovú teplotu. Vychladnutý olej vyšľaháme so soľou a citrónovou alebo kalamansiovou šťavou a dáme bokom.

4. **NA OMÁČKU SAWSAWAN:** V stredne veľkej mise vyšľaháme sinamak, citrónovú alebo kalamansiovú šťavu (ak ju používame), sójovú omáčku (ak ju používame) a čili papričky (ak ich používame), kým sa nespoja, a dáme bokom.

5. **GRILOVANIE:** Zapálime jeden plný komínový podpaľovač dreveného uhlia. Keď je všetko uhlie rozpálené a pokryté sivým popolom, vysypeme ho a rovnomerne rozprestrieme na polovicu uhoľného roštu. Vložíme grilovací rošt, gril prikryjeme a necháme 5 minút predhriať. Prípadne na plynovom grile nastavíme polovicu horákov na najvyšší stupeň, prikryjeme a predhrievame 10 minút. Grilovací rošt očistíme a naolejujeme.

6. Kura vyberieme z marinády, necháme prebytok odkvapkať a preložíme na plech s okrajom; marinádu vylejeme. Kura zo všetkých strán potrieme annattovým olejom a položíme kožou nahor na chladnejšiu stranu grilu. Gril prikryjeme (na grile na drevené uhlie otvoríme prieduchy na veku nad kuraťom aj spodné prieduchy) a grilujeme 5 minút. Kura obrátime, potrieme annattovým olejom, prikryjeme a grilujeme 5 minút. Pokračujeme v grilovaní, každých 5 minút kura obraciame a potierame annattovým olejom, kým vpichový teplomer zapichnutý do najhrubšej časti stehna neukáže 60 °C, spolu asi 20 minút.

7. Kura zo všetkých strán potrieme annattovým olejom a položíme kožou nadol nad teplejšiu stranu grilu. Prikryjeme a grilujeme, kým koža nie je chrumkavá a vpichový teplomer zapichnutý do najhrubšej časti stehna neukáže 74 °C, ešte asi 5 minút; veko dvíhame len na čas merania teploty, pretože prístup vzduchu podporuje vzplanutia a pripálenie. Ak by sa kura pripaľovalo skôr, ako dosiahne požadovanú teplotu, presunieme ho na chladnejšiu stranu grilu, prikryjeme a dogrilujeme. Kura preložíme na mriežku vloženú do plechu s okrajom a necháme 5 minút odpočívať.

8. **V RÚRE A NA SPORÁKU:** Rošt nastavíme do stredu rúry a rúru predhrejeme na 218 °C (teplovzdušnú na 198 °C). Plech s okrajom vystelieme alobalom a položíme naň mriežku. Kura vyberieme z marinády, necháme prebytok odkvapkať a položíme ho kožou nadol na pripravenú mriežku; marinádu vylejeme. Kura zo všetkých strán potrieme annattovým olejom a pečieme 10 minút. Obrátime kožou nahor, zo všetkých strán potrieme annattovým olejom a pečieme 10 minút. Pokračujeme v pečení, kura obraciame a potierame annattovým olejom, kým zľahka nezhnedne a vpichový teplomer zapichnutý do najhrubšej časti stehna neukáže 74 °C, ešte asi 10 minút. Kura vyberieme z rúry, z oboch strán potrieme annattovým olejom a dáme bokom.

9. Liatinovú panvicu alebo grilovaciu panvicu rozohrejeme na silnom ohni, kým zľahka nedymí. Panvicu zľahka potrieme olejom a kura opekáme kožou nadol, kým sa zľahka neopáli, asi 3 minúty. Kura preložíme na mriežku vloženú do plechu s okrajom a necháme 5 minút odpočívať.
10. **PODÁVANIE:** Kura preložíme na servírovaciu tácku, ozdobíme jarnou cibuľkou a vyprážaným cesnakom a ihneď podávame s omáčkou sawsawan a bielou alebo cesnakovou vyprážanou ryžou.

1. For the marinated chicken: In a large bowl or zipper-lock bag, toss together chicken, lemon juice, diced onion, lime juice, oil, Scotch bonnet pepper, and salt until well combined. Cover bowl or seal bag, then marinate in the refrigerator for at least 8 and up to 12 hours.

2. For the Yassa: Remove chicken from the marinade, scraping off any onions and pepper; discard the marinade. Using paper towels, blot chicken dry. In a Dutch oven, heat oil over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add chicken, skin-side down, and cook until well browned, about 6 minutes. Using a thin metal spatula, turn chicken and cook on second side until browned, about 5 minutes longer. Remove from heat and transfer chicken to a platter.

3. Lower heat to medium, add sliced onions, and cook, stirring frequently, until onions are softened, about 7 minutes. Continue to cook, stirring and scraping frequently, until onions are dark brown and caramelized, about 15 minutes. Stir in garlic and mustard and cook until fragrant and slightly softened, about 1 minute.

4. Add chicken stock, Scotch bonnet pepper, bay leaf, and chicken along with any accumulated juices, nestling chicken pieces into the onions; season lightly with salt and pepper. Bring to a boil over high heat.

5. Reduce heat to medium-low and cook, gently stirring and scraping the bottom of the pot occasionally, until chicken is cooked through and beginning to fall from the bone, about 1 hour. Season with salt, if needed. Serve with rice, couscous, or fonio, and lemon or lime wedges.

1. **NA MARINOVANÉ KURA:** Vo veľkej mise alebo v uzatvárateľnom vrecku premiešame kura, citrónovú šťavu, na kocky nakrájanú cibuľu, limetkovú šťavu, olej, papričku scotch bonnet a soľ, kým sa všetko dobre nespojí. Misu prikryjeme alebo vrecko uzavrieme a necháme marinovať v chladničke aspoň 8 a najviac 12 hodín.

2. **NA YASSU:** Kura vyberieme z marinády, oškrabeme z neho cibuľu a papričku; marinádu vylejeme. Kura osušíme papierovými utierkami. V liatinovom hrnci rozohrejeme na stredne silnom až silnom ohni olej, kým sa neleskne. Pridáme kura kožou nadol a opekáme, kým pekne nezhnedne, asi 6 minút. Tenkou kovovou obracačkou kura obrátime a opekáme, kým aj druhá strana nezhnedne, ešte asi 5 minút. Odstavíme z ohňa a kura preložíme na tácku.

3. Stlmíme na stredný oheň, pridáme nakrájanú cibuľu a za častého miešania dusíme, kým cibuľa nezmäkne, asi 7 minút. 4. Pridáme kurací vývar, papričku scotch bonnet, bobkový list a kura spolu s vytečenou šťavou a kúsky kuraťa vnoríme do cibule; zľahka osolíme a okoreníme. Na silnom ohni privedieme do varu.

1. Adjust oven rack to upper-middle position. Heat oven to 220 °C (fan 200 °C). On a rimmed baking sheet, combine chicken and potatoes. Drizzle with oil and sprinkle evenly with sumac, allspice, coriander, cinnamon, ginger, cardamom, pepper, and salt. Rub all over and toss to ensure chicken and potatoes are evenly coated. Transfer chicken to a bowl or plate and spread potatoes in an even layer on baking sheet. For better salt penetration, let chicken sit at room temperature for 30 minutes or uncovered in the refrigerator for up to 8 hours, if desired.

2. Bake potatoes for 10 minutes. Remove rimmed baking sheet from oven, add onions, and toss gently with potatoes to combine. Return chicken to rimmed baking sheet, placing pieces along the edges of the pan, on top of potato and onion mixture for better browning. Return baking sheet to oven and cook until potatoes are almost tender and chicken is beginning to crisp, about 30 minutes. Remove pan from oven, scatter oregano on top of chicken and potatoes, return to oven, and continue to cook until potatoes are tender and chicken is golden brown and crisp, 10 to 15 minutes. Sprinkle with additional sumac and serve with lemon wedges and yogurt.

sk.v: Ryžu môžeme namočiť a scediť až 1 deň vopred a do plnenia kurčiat ju uchovávať v chladničke. Polievku môžeme pripraviť až 5 dní vopred a potom ju jemne ohrievať, kým sa kurčatá úplne neprehrejú (vpichovým teplomerom overíme, že teplo preniklo až do stredu plnky)

c.t: Hwanggi, eomnamu and the other Korean ingredients are sold in well-stocked Korean markets; use what you can get. Some stores sell ready-made samgyetang ingredient packets.

To peel gingko nuts, roast them in a lightly oiled pan over medium heat, stirring often, until they start popping out of their skins; lower the heat and cook until the skins loosen further, then rub them together in a paper towel to remove the skins.
Hwanggi, eomnamu a ostatné kórejské suroviny dostanete v dobre zásobených kórejských obchodoch; použite, čo zoženiete. Niektoré obchody predávajú hotové balíčky surovín na samgyetang.

Ak treba ginkgové oriešky olúpať, opečte ich na zľahka naolejovanej panvici na strednom ohni za častého miešania, kým nezačnú vyskakovať zo šupiek; stlmte oheň a opekajte, kým sa šupky ešte viac neuvoľnia, potom ich v papierovej utierke pošúchajte o seba a šupky odstráňte.

1 piece hwanggi (황기, milk vetch) root (about 10 g)
1 piece eomnamu (엄나무, prickly castor-oil tree) bark
2 small young chickens or Cornish hens (about 400 g each)
6 small (about 2.5 cm in length) or 4 large (about 5 cm in length) dried jujubes, pitted
6 whole skinned gingko nuts
2 to 4 raw chestnuts, peeled
2 pieces fresh ginseng (about 10cm long), or 2 large slices dried ginseng
4 medium cloves garlic
Thinly sliced scallions, for garnish
A mixture of salt, freshly ground black pepper, and ground toasted sesame seeds, for serving

1 kúsok koreňa hwanggi (황기, kozinec blanitý; asi 10 g)
1 kúsok kôry eomnamu (엄나무, kalopanax)
2 malé mladé kurčatá alebo kuriatka Cornish (po asi 400 g)
6 malých (asi 2,5 cm dlhých) alebo 4 veľké (asi 5 cm dlhé) sušené jujuby (čínske datle), bez kôstok
6 celých olúpaných semien ginka
2 až 4 surové jedlé gaštany, olúpané
2 kúsky čerstvého ženšenu (asi 10 cm dlhé) alebo 2 veľké plátky sušeného ženšenu
4 stredné strúčiky cesnaku
jarné cibuľky, nakrájané na tenké plátky, na ozdobu
zmes soli, čerstvo mletého čierneho korenia a mletého praženého sezamu na podávanie

en.t: 1. In a medium bowl, cover rice with 2.5 cm of cold water and soak for 2 hours. Drain rice.
2. Wash hwanggi and eomnamu under cold running water, using a clean brush to dislodge any grit. Place hwanggi and eomnamu in a large saucepan, cover with 2000 ml cold water, and soak for 2 hours.
3. Transfer pot to the stovetop and bring to a simmer. Gently simmer hwanggi and eomnamu for 1 hour.
4. Meanwhile, trim off chickens' wing tips, tail, and excess fat. Clean inside of chicken cavity well, trying to remove any blood stuck between the ribs.
5. Stuff each chicken with alternating layers of sticky rice, jujubes, gingko, chestnuts, ginseng, and garlic.

6. Using a paring knife, cut a small slit into the skin on either side of the cavity. Cross the drumsticks, inserting the end of each drumstick through the slit on the opposite side of the cavity (this trusses the bird and seals the cavity without the need for string).
7. Strain the hwanggi and eomnamu from the broth, discarding the solids. Top up the broth with fresh water to equal 2000 ml.

8. In a heavy, large pot or Dutch oven, arrange the stuffed birds side-by-side. Pour the broth over them. Cover and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and gently simmer until the birds are fully cooked through and tender, about 2 hours. If the broth doesn't fully cover the birds, rotate them halfway through cooking.

9. Transfer each stuffed bird to a deep serving bowl or small earthenware pot and ladle the broth on top. Garnish with scallions and serve with the salt/pepper/sesame seed mixture alongside, so that each person can season the soup and chicken to their tastes.

sk.t: 1. V stredne veľkej mise zalejeme ryžu studenou vodou tak, aby ju prevyšovala o 2,5 cm, a necháme 2 hodiny namáčať. Ryžu scedíme.

2. Hwanggi a eomnamu umyjeme pod tečúcou studenou vodou a čistou kefkou odstránime všetky nečistoty. Hwanggi a eomnamu dáme do veľkého hrnca, zalejeme 2000 ml studenej vody a necháme 2 hodiny namáčať.
3. Hrniec preložíme na sporák a privedieme do mierneho varu. Hwanggi a eomnamu jemne varíme 1 hodinu.
4. Medzitým kurčatám odrežeme špičky krídel, chvost a prebytočný tuk. Dutinu kurčaťa dôkladne vyčistíme a snažíme sa odstrániť krv zachytenú medzi rebrami.
5. Každé kurča naplníme striedavými vrstvami lepkavej ryže, jujúb, ginka, gaštanov, ženšenu a cesnaku.

6. Malým nožom urobíme do kože na oboch stranách dutiny malý zárez. Paličky prekrížime a koniec každej paličky prestrčíme cez zárez na opačnej strane dutiny (tým vtáka zviažeme a dutinu uzavrieme bez špagátu).
7. Hwanggi a eomnamu z vývaru vylovíme a vyhodíme. Vývar doplníme čerstvou vodou na 2000 ml.

8. Do ťažkého veľkého hrnca alebo liatinového hrnca uložíme naplnené vtáky vedľa seba. Zalejeme ich vývarom. Prikryjeme a privedieme do varu, potom stlmíme oheň a jemne varíme, kým nie sú vtáky úplne uvarené a mäkké, asi 2 hodiny. Ak vývar vtáky úplne neprekrýva, v polovici varenia ich obrátime.

9. Každého naplneného vtáka preložíme do hlbokej servírovacej misy alebo malého hlineného hrnca a zalejeme vývarom. Ozdobíme jarnou cibuľkou a podávame so zmesou soli, korenia a sezamu bokom, aby si každý mohol polievku aj kurča dochutiť podľa seba.

4. Fry chicken, stirring to prevent pieces from sticking together and adjusting heat as necessary to maintain oil temperature of 175 °C, until chicken begins to crisp, turn slightly golden, and registers about 32 °C, about 5 minutes. 1. V malom kastróliku zmiešame 59 ml vody, cukor, sójovú omáčku, cesnak, ryžový ocot a sriracha omáčku. Na strednom ohni privedieme do mierneho varu a varíme, kým nie je zmes sirupová, asi 5 minút. Necháme vychladnúť na izbovú teplotu. (Omáčka vydrží vo vzduchotesnej nádobe v chladničke až 1 deň.)

2. Rošt nastavíme do stredu rúry a rúru rozohrejeme na 95 °C (teplovzdušnú na 75 °C). V liatinovom hrnci rozohrejeme na stredne silnom až silnom ohni olej na 175 °C. Do 2 plechov s okrajom vložíme mriežky; dáme bokom.

3. Do širokej plytkej misy preosejeme 56 g kukuričného škrobu. Nad veľkú misu položíme jemné sitko. Kura osušíme papierovými utierkami a ochutíme 1 ČL (2,5 g) soli a korením. Po niekoľkých kúskoch kura dôkladne obalíme v škrobe, potom ho preložíme do sitka a energicky pretrasieme, aby zostala len tenká vrstva škrobu. Kura preložíme na jednu z mriežok.

4. Kura vyprážame, miešame, aby sa kúsky nezlepili, a oheň podľa potreby upravujeme, aby sa teplota oleja držala na 175 °C, kým kura nezačne chrumkavieť, mierne nezozlatne a nedosiahne asi 32 °C, asi 5 minút. Vyprážané kura preložíme na druhú pripravenú mriežku a necháme 5 až 6 minút postáť. Obalíme a vyprážame zvyšné kura.

5. Plech vystelieme trojitou vrstvou papierových utierok a olej na stredne silnom až silnom ohni opäť zohrejeme na 175 °C. Prvú dávku vyprážaného kuraťa vrátime do oleja a vyprážame ďalej, kým povrch nie je veľmi chrumkavý, sýto zlatohnedý a mäso nedosiahne asi 70 °C v prsiach alebo 80 °C v stehnách či paličkách, 3 až 6 minút. Kura preložíme na plech vystlaný papierovými utierkami, necháme odkvapkať a udržiavame v teple v rúre. Zopakujeme s druhou dávkou; druhú dávku necháme odkvapkať asi 1 minútu. (Vyprážané krídelká bez omáčky môžeme udržiavať v rúre s teplotou 95 °C (teplovzdušnou 75 °C) až 1 hodinu.)
6. Kura preložíme do veľkej misy, pokvapkáme omáčkou a jemne premiešame, kým nie je rovnomerne obalené. Preložíme na tácku, posypeme jarnou cibuľkou a podávame.

c.t: Oil: 1–2 tbsp oil, sprayed or brushed on (instead of the frying oil)

Steps:
1. Make the sauce as in step 1. Season the chicken and coat it thoroughly in the cornstarch only, shaking off the excess (skip the wet batter).
2. Spray the pieces all over with oil until no dry starch is visible and lay them in the basket, skin side up, in a single layer.
3. Air-fry until deep golden and crisp, 25–30 minutes, turning and spraying them halfway, until 70 °C inside for breasts or 80 °C for thighs and drumsticks.
4. Toss with the sauce and sprinkle with scallions as in step 6.

1. Omáčku pripravíme podľa kroku 1. Kuracie mäso ochutíme a dôkladne obalíme iba v kukuričnom škrobe, prebytok striasieme (riedke cestíčko vynecháme).
2. Kúsky zo všetkých strán postriekame olejom, kým nie je vidieť suchý škrob, a uložíme ich do koša kožou nahor v jednej vrstve.
3. Pečieme do sýtozlatista a dochrumkava 25–30 minút; v polovici ich obrátime a postriekame, kým vnútri nemajú 70 °C pri prsiach alebo 80 °C pri stehnách a paličkách.
4. Premiešame s omáčkou a posypeme jarnou cibuľkou podľa kroku 6.

en.t: 6 medium cloves garlic
12 sprigs cilantro, including thick stalks
3 tbsp (45 g) palm or light brown sugar
2 tsp (10 g) ground white pepper
1 tsp (5 g) ground coriander
2 tbsp (30 ml) fish sauce
2 tsp (10 ml) dark soy sauce
2 (7.5 cm) segments lemongrass (optional)
1 whole chicken, spine removed, split in half along the breastbone
10 to 12 red Thai bird chillies, finely minced, for the dipping sauce
4 garlic cloves, finely minced (about 4 tsp), for the dipping sauce
60 ml Asian fish sauce, for the dipping sauce
120 ml palm or light brown sugar, for the dipping sauce
3 tbsp (45 ml) distilled white vinegar, for the dipping sauce
2 tbsp (30 ml) fresh lime juice, for the dipping sauce

1. Make the dipping sauce: Combine all the dipping-sauce ingredients in a small sealable container. Shake well and set aside until the sugar dissolves, shaking every 10 minutes or so. Refrigerate until ready to use (it keeps for up to 3 weeks).
2. Combine garlic, cilantro, sugar, white pepper, coriander, fish sauce, dark soy sauce, and lemongrass (if using) in the bowl of a food processor. Process until a rough paste is formed. Set aside.

3. Place chicken halves flat on a cutting board. Insert 2 metal skewers into each chicken half, running parallel through legs and breasts. Transfer chicken to a baking dish that just fits them. Rub on all surfaces with marinade. Cover, transfer to refrigerator, and allow to marinate for at least 2 hours and up to overnight.

4. When ready to cook, light 1 chimney full of charcoal. When all charcoal is lit and covered with gray ash, pour out and spread coals evenly over half of coal grate. Alternatively, set half the burners of a gas grill to high heat. Set cooking grate in place, cover grill, and allow to preheat for 5 minutes. Clean and oil grilling grate.

5. Place chicken, skin side up, on cooler side of grill, with legs facing toward hotter side. Cover grill, with vents on lid open and aligned over chicken. Open bottom vents of grill. Cook until an instant-read thermometer inserted into thickest part of breast registers 60 °C, about 45 minutes. Carefully flip chicken and place, skin side down, on hotter side of grill, with breasts pointed toward cooler side. Cover and cook until skin is crisp and an instant-read thermometer inserted into thickest part of breast registers 63 to 66 °C, about 3 minutes longer. (Be careful, as the skin is very prone to burning.) If chicken threatens to burn before temperature is achieved, carefully slide to cooler side of grill, cover, and continue to cook until done. Do not leave lid off for longer than it takes to check temperature, or chicken will burn.
6. Transfer chicken to a cutting board and allow to rest for 5 minutes. Carve and serve with chile dipping sauce.

1. Pripravíme omáčku na namáčanie: všetky suroviny na omáčku dáme do malej uzatvárateľnej nádoby. Dobre pretrepeme a necháme odstáť, kým sa cukor nerozpustí; približne každých 10 minút pretrepeme. Do použitia uchovávame v chladničke (vydrží až 3 týždne).

2. Do misy kuchynského robota dáme cesnak, koriandrovú vňať, cukor, biele korenie, koriander, rybaciu omáčku, tmavú sójovú omáčku a citrónovú trávu (ak ju používame). Rozmixujeme na hrubú pastu. Dáme bokom.

3. Polovice kuraťa položíme naplocho na dosku na krájanie. Do každej polovice zapichneme 2 kovové ražniči, ktoré vedú rovnobežne cez stehno a prsia. Kura preložíme do zapekacej misy, do ktorej sa akurát zmestí. Zo všetkých strán ho potrieme marinádou. Prikryjeme, dáme do chladničky a necháme marinovať aspoň 2 hodiny a najviac cez noc.

4. Keď sme pripravení grilovať, zapálime 1 plný komínový podpaľovač dreveného uhlia. Keď je všetko uhlie rozpálené a pokryté sivým popolom, vysypeme ho a rovnomerne rozprestrieme na polovicu uhoľného roštu. Prípadne na plynovom grile nastavíme polovicu horákov na silný plameň. Vložíme grilovací rošt, gril prikryjeme a necháme 5 minút predhriať. Grilovací rošt očistíme a naolejujeme.

5. Kura položíme kožou nahor na chladnejšiu stranu grilu, stehnami k teplejšej strane. Gril prikryjeme, prieduchy na veku otvoríme a nasmerujeme nad kura. Otvoríme spodné prieduchy grilu. Grilujeme, kým vpichový teplomer zapichnutý do najhrubšej časti pŕs neukáže 60 °C, asi 45 minút. Kura opatrne obrátime a položíme kožou nadol na teplejšiu stranu grilu, prsiami k chladnejšej strane. Prikryjeme a grilujeme, kým koža nie je chrumkavá a vpichový teplomer zapichnutý do najhrubšej časti pŕs neukáže 63 až 66 °C, ešte asi 3 minúty. (Dávame pozor, koža sa veľmi ľahko pripáli.) Ak by sa kura pripaľovalo skôr, ako dosiahne požadovanú teplotu, opatrne ho presunieme na chladnejšiu stranu grilu, prikryjeme a dogrilujeme. Veko nenechávame otvorené dlhšie, ako trvá zmeranie teploty, inak sa kura pripáli.
6. Kura preložíme na dosku na krájanie a necháme 5 minút odpočívať. Nakrájame a podávame s čili omáčkou na namáčanie.

1. Pour chicken stock into a 235 ml liquid measuring cup and sprinkle gelatin over the top. Set aside.

2. Season chicken pieces generously on all sides with salt and pepper. Heat vegetable oil in a large straight-sided sauté pan or a Dutch oven over medium-high heat until lightly smoking. Add chicken pieces skin-side-down in a single layer and cook without moving until deep golden brown, about 8 minutes. As the chicken pieces finish browning, flip them over and cook until the second side is light golden brown, about 2 minutes longer. Transfer chicken to a large plate and set aside. Pour off all but 1 tbsp (15 ml) of fat from pan.

3. Add onions and bell peppers (if using) to the pan and cook, stirring and scraping up any browned bits from the bottom, until the onions are tender and just starting to brown, about 5 minutes. Add paprika and cook, stirring, until fragrant and nutty, about 1 minute.

4. Add stock/gelatin mixture and scrape up anything stuck to the bottom of the pan, stirring constantly. Add bay leaf. Nestle seared chicken pieces back into the sauce, leaving them skin-side up. Reduce heat to lowest setting, cover pan, and cook until chicken is completely tender, about 30 minutes.

5. Remove chicken pieces and set aside on a large plate. Whisk sour cream, fish sauce, lemon juice, and half of minced parsley or dill into sauce. Season to taste with salt and more paprika if desired. Return chicken to pan and turn to coat in sauce.

6. Serve immediately over noodles, boiled potatoes, or spaetzle, tossing the noodles or potatoes with the sauce and placing the chicken on top. Garnish with more sour cream, paprika, and minced fresh parsley or dill (if using)

1. Kurací vývar nalejeme do odmerky na tekutiny s objemom 235 ml a navrch nasypeme želatínu. Dáme bokom.

2. Kúsky kuraťa zo všetkých strán výdatne osolíme a okoreníme. Pridáme kúsky kuraťa kožou nadol v jednej vrstve a bez hýbania opekáme, kým nie sú sýto zlatohnedé, asi 8 minút. Opečené kúsky obrátime a opekáme, kým aj druhá strana nie je svetlo zlatohnedá, ešte asi 2 minúty. Kura preložíme na veľký tanier a dáme bokom. Z panvice zlejeme všetok tuk okrem 1 PL (15 ml).

1. **BRINE CHICKEN:**

2. Whisk 1890 ml cold water, 120 ml hot sauce, 120 ml table salt, and 120 ml sugar in large bowl until salt and sugar dissolve. Add 1 whole chicken, quartered, and refrigerate, covered, for 30 minutes or up to 1 hour.
3. **BLOOM SPICES:**

4. Heat 3 tbsp (44 ml) peanut oil in small saucepan over medium heat until shimmering. Add 1 tbsp (15 ml) cayenne pepper, ½ tsp (2.5 ml) paprika, ½ tsp (2.5 ml) table salt, ¼ tsp (1.2 ml) garlic powder, and ½ tsp (2.5 ml) sugar and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Transfer to small bowl.
5. **DREDGE:**

8. Adjust oven rack to middle position and heat oven to 95 °C (fan 75 °C). Heat remaining oil in large Dutch oven over medium-high heat to 175 °C. Return chicken pieces to flour mixture and turn to coat. Fry half of chicken, adjusting burner as necessary to maintain oil temperature between 150 and 165 °C, until deep golden brown and white meat registers 70 °C (80 °C for dark meat), 20 to 25 minutes. en.t: 4 long, thin sirloin tip steaks (about 905 g)
84 g cornstarch
1 egg
235 ml buttermilk, divided
240 g all-purpose flour
2 tsp (6 g) kosher salt, plus more to taste
2 tsp (10 ml) paprika
2 tsp (10 ml) freshly ground black pepper
1 1/2 tsp (7.5 ml) onion powder
1 1/2 tsp (7.5 ml) garlic powder
1 tsp (4 g) baking powder
1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) cayenne pepper

590 ml whole milk

1. For the Steaks: Pat steaks dry with paper towels. Place one steak in a resealable plastic bag. Using a meat pounder, rolling pin, or small skillet, pound steak out to an even 0.3–0.5 cm thickness. Repeat with remaining 3 steaks. Season steaks with salt.

2. Place cornstarch in a shallow dish. Whisk together egg and 160 ml buttermilk in a separate shallow dish. Whisk together flour, 2 tsp (10 ml) salt, paprika, black pepper, onion powder, garlic powder, baking powder, and cayenne pepper in a third shallow dish. Drizzle remaining 79 ml of buttermilk into seasoned flour and rub with fingertips until mixture is coarse like wet sand.

3. Working one steak at a time, coat well in cornstarch. Lift steak, shake off excess cornstarch, then transfer to egg mixture. Coat steak well in egg mixture, lift steak, letting excess egg drain off, then transfer to seasoned buttermilk-flour mixture. Coat steak well, pressing seasoned flour all over to help it adhere to the meat. Lift steak, shake off excess flour, and transfer to a wire rack. Repeat with remaining steaks. Let steaks stand for 10 minutes.

4. Place oil in a large Dutch oven or wok and heat to 190 °C over high heat. Carefully lift 1 steak and gently slide into oil. Cook, flipping occasionally, until golden brown and crisp on both sides, 2 to 4 minutes total. Transfer steak to a paper towel-lined tray and season with salt to taste. Repeat with remaining 3 steaks.

5. For the Gravy: Transfer 59 ml of hot frying oil to a medium saucepan over medium-high heat. Add flour and whisk constantly until mixture turns light brown, about 1 minute. Slowly whisk in milk. Stir in pepper and bring to a boil. Reduce to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat; season with salt and additional pepper to taste.
6. Transfer steaks to plates, top with gravy, and serve immediately.

Salt and freshly ground pepper

1. Place the chopped onion, ginger, garlic, and 4 tbsp (59 ml) of water into a blender. Puree until smooth.
2. Spread the cut-up chicken out on a plate. Sprinkle lightly with salt and pepper and let sit.
3. Place the flour in a bowl. Slowly add 235 ml of the chicken broth to mix well.

4. Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and add the oil. When the oil is hot, toss in the chicken and stir-fry until lightly browned. Some of the fat will render from the chicken skin. Remove the chicken with a slotted spoon.

5. Add the sliced onions to the pan and cook slowly, allowing the onions to caramelize over the course of five to seven minutes. Towards the end of that time when the onions are beginning to brown, add the turmeric and paprika.

6. In a pot suited for soups, add the chicken along with the juices that will have settled, the sautéed onions, the onion and ginger puree, and the remaining 475 ml of chicken broth. Carefully add the chickpea flour and broth mixture, mixing quickly so that the flour won't clump.
7. Bring the pot to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer gently, uncovered, for 15 minutes. Season to taste with more salt, if needed.
8. Add the coconut milk. Stir to mix and return to a simmer. Serve with noodles and garnishes as desired.
